name: damson
description: Skills for driving damson, the native macOS GPU terminal, from Claude Code.

plugins.name: damson-orchestration
plugins.description: Run several coding agents as labelled tabs inside a running damson terminal, each in its own git worktree, watch for the one that is blocked on you, and tear the run down. Agent-agnostic: claude, codex, grok, cursor-agent. Wraps damson-cli and damson-crew.
